title: Everyday processes
sub: Step-by-step routines, drawn as a timeline.

items.heading: Boil water
items.body: Bring a cup of water to a rolling boil with crushed ginger and cardamom.

items.heading: Add tea leaves
items.body: Stir in a spoon of black tea and let it steep for 2 to 3 minutes.

items.heading: Pour in milk
items.body: Add half a cup of milk and sugar to taste.

items.heading: Simmer
items.body: Let it rise once or twice on a medium flame, then lower the heat.

items.heading: Strain and serve
items.body: Pour through a strainer into a cup and serve hot.

items.heading: Draft
items.body: A member writes and introduces the bill.

items.heading: Committee
items.body: A small group reviews, amends and votes on it.

items.heading: Floor vote
items.body: The full chamber debates and votes.

items.heading: Signature
items.body: The head of state signs it into law.
